$comment: Fake deployment scenario of the application-driven acceptance
scenario with two differences that make the recorded row informative:
each joint reports a nonzero torque estimate, and the IMU snapshot is
marked valid with a fresh receive stamp. The measured position stays at
zero so the initialization target is reached and the recorder's tracking
window is the same as in the static run.
The fake backend does not model the IMU vectors themselves; their default
zero values are a valid measurement, and the test asserts the recorded
valid flag and receive stamp rather than inventing sample content.
